data.title: 2 Euros (50 Years of U2)

composition.text:
Bimetallico: centro in nickel
 rivestito di ottone al nichel con anello in rame-nichel (Core: 75% Cu, 20% Zn, 5% Ni Ring: 75% Cu, 25% Ni)

obverse.description:
(en) The obverse features the four members of the band U2.
 (L-R) Adam Clayton, Bono, The Edge and Larry Mullen Jr.
mint mark (Caduceus)

reverse.description: Una mappa geografica dell'Europa occidentale si estende sull'anello esterno e sul nucleo interno del lato destro della moneta. L'iscrizione 2 EURO è sovrapposta alla mappa dell'Europa, con la cifra "2" situata in un campo aperto che rappresenta l'Oceano Atlantico orientale. 12 stelle si trovano sul lato destro dell'anello esterno, con sei stelle sopra la mappa dell'Europa e sei stelle sotto di essa; sei strisce verticali attraversano il nucleo interno della moneta, collegando visivamente i segmenti superiori e inferiori delle stelle.

data.comments:
(en)

The coin will be dedicated to mark 50 years since the formation of Irish band U2 in 1976. The national side of the coin depicts the name of the band U2 along with an image of all four band members (L-R) Adam Clayton, Bono, The Edge and Larry Mullen Jr. It also references the band’s 50th Anniversary (1976-2026), as well as the name of the issuing member state, Ireland, in Irish – Éire. Formed in 1976 after Larry Mullen Jr. posted a sign which read ‘Drummer Seeks Musicians’ on the school noticeboard at Dublin’s Mount Temple Comprehensive school,’ U2 has gone on to be acknowledged as one of the best live acts in the world, touring the globe countless times; released 15 studio albums; sold over 175m albums; and won numerous awards, including 22 Grammys and Amnesty International’s Ambassador of Conscience award.

 

BU coincard (issue price €14.95)
